messages.content: You are L8 draft v1. User: "Write a bash script that finds all .log files under the current directory modified in the last 24 hours and tars them into archive.tar.gz. Output only the script in a single code block, no explanation."

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

find . -type f -name '*.log' -mtime -1 -print0 | \
  tar --null -czf archive.tar.gz --files-from=-
```
